headline: Jensen Huang's leather jacket becomes a meme after resignation
summary: Jensen Huang's signature black leather jacket, long a symbol of his Nvidia persona, has become the target of memes and fashion commentary following his resignation, with commentators and stylists mocking the look as a midlife-crisis cliche.
